column3: priority (1 = most likely to be hit by a real script/user, 4 = rare)

column1: # first matching row wins; used by warncheck.py --update-known (reasons) and scripts/warn_baseline.py (BASELINE.md)

column2: /version text is the client's (a client registers its own /version; the engine has no version banner of tf's build)
/connect is a client feature: the engine answers "not supported by this client" (documented client-registered form)
/help and the squat bridge commands belong to the client; unregistered they answer "not supported by this client"
/edit $<text> (select a macro by its trigger text) is not implemented: "not supported by this client"
the last line of the case is a rate-limit message from a hook tf fires at exit (/quit); gtfparser has no such hook there
status and terminal variable checks run in the terminal layer, which a client drives with PollVars; the headless gtfrun has no terminal
wider than screen (N): the screen width is the client's (gtfrun is 80 columns, the reference pty 4000)
LC_CTYPE/LC_TIME banner: tf reports the C library locale it adopted; gtfparser has none
%default_charset names are checked against tf's ICU converter list; gtfparser does not carry it
